article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
The tallest trees in the world
The tallest trees in the world are called redwoods and they grow in California. These trees can (21).................. reach heights of around 91 metres. Among the enormous redwoods, one giant tree beats them all. This tree was discovered and measured in 2006. The National Park Service then (22).................. that at 115.7 metres, it was the tallest tree in the world. Now it is so famous that it even has a name, "Hyperion". In California, there are other giant redwoods which are just a little shorter than Hyperion. The exact (23).................. of any of the enormous trees is kept secret to prevent them from being (24)...................
A (25).................. redwood lives from 500 to 700 years, although some have been found that are more than 2,000 years old. The National Park Service says that the redwoods' great height is (26).................. due to the climate in California; there is heavy rain every year and the temperatures are mild.

questions.explanation:
B. easily
“这些树能轻易地达到约 91 米的高度”，“easily” 表示 “容易地、轻易地”，符合树木自然生长高度的语境。
A. clearly（清晰地）、C. obviously（明显地）、D. luckily（幸运地）均与 “生长高度” 的逻辑不匹配。
拓展：“easily” 可修饰动词，表示能力或可能性，如 “easily solve the problem（轻易解决问题）”。

B. announced
国家公园管理局 “宣布” 这棵树高 115.7 米，是世界最高树，“announce” 意为 “宣布、宣告”，后接 that 从句，符合官方发布信息的场景。
A. answered（回答）、C. told（告诉）、D. spoke（说话）均无法体现 “正式公布” 的含义。
拓展：“announce” 的名词形式为 “announcement（公告）”，常见搭配：announce a decision（宣布决定）。

A. location
“任何巨型树木的确切位置都被保密”，“location” 指 “位置、地点”，与 “防止被破坏” 的目的对应。
B. route（路线）、C. destination（目的地）、D. point（点）均与 “树木所在地点” 无关。
拓展：“keep sth. secret” 表示 “对某事保密”，类似表达：keep a secret（保守秘密）。

B. damaged
保密位置是为了防止树木被 “破坏”，“damaged” 指 “损害、破坏”，符合保护树木的语境。
A. wasted（浪费）、C. worn（磨损）、D. injured（受伤）多形容人或物体损耗，不用于树木被人为破坏的场景。
拓展：“prevent sb./sth. from doing” 意为 “阻止…… 做某事”，如 “prevent the environment from being polluted（防止环境被污染）”。

D. typical
“典型的红杉树寿命为 500 到 700 年”，“typical” 表示 “典型的、有代表性的”，指大多数红杉的普遍寿命。
A. familiar（熟悉的）、B. usual（通常的）、C. general（一般的）均不如 “typical” 准确描述 “代表性个体”。
拓展：“typical” 的常用搭配：a typical example（典型例子），typically（adv. 典型地）。

A. mainly
红杉的高度 “主要” 归因于加州气候，“mainly” 意为 “主要地、大部分”，强调气候是主要原因。
B. extremely（极其）、C. properly（恰当地）、D. finally（最终）均不符合 “因果关系中强调主要因素” 的逻辑。
拓展：“be due to” 表示 “归因于”，后接原因，如 “Success is due to hard work（成功源于努力）”。
